startup.fix: Enable the required tools in Antigravity, or configure the adapter access flags for headless sandbox execution.

startup.pattern: unsupported model|invalid model|model .*(not supported|not found|not available)|not supported when using
startup.fix: Choose a model supported by the logged-in account in .orchestra/config.json.
Install the sandbox dependencies named in stderr, or correct the CLI sandbox settings.

startup.pattern: not logged in|please log.?in|login required|authentication (failed|required)|invalid api key
startup.fix: Open Antigravity and sign in, then retry `orchestra adapter test agy`.

startup.what: the installed CLI does not support an adapter flag
startup.fix: Update agy or override its adapter flags in .orchestra/adapters/agy.json to match the installed version.
